description.text: Ideological and political education as a discipline is aimed to explore the laws in the ideological, moral formation and development and the laws of ideological and political education by adopting Marxist theories and methods in order to cultivate the students' correct world outlooks on the world, life and values. The discipline aims to train people with a firm Marxism belief, a systematic knowledge of the Marxism principles and the Chinese version of Marxist theory, a comprehensive grasp of the ideological and political education theory and methods. They should be familiar with the ideological and moral formation and development and the laws of ideological and political education , have a good master of a foreign language and can understand literature in their own field in that language., know about the latest developments in their area, and qualify themselves for teaching, scientific research, party government league work, and student education and management concerned with the discipline. The discipline has a rationally-structured academic echelon of professors and associate professor, with fruits in ideological and political work and research within the information network environment, and has developed a subject of its own characteristics. Teachers in the discipline have carried out a number of national social science fund projects and provincial & ministerial research projects.

duration.text: The Ideological and political education at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Undergraduate school transcript 5.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 6.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 6 or above
